What is commercial loan underwriting?


Commercial loan underwriting is judging whether a business can repay a loan: reading its financials, testing them against the lender’s credit policy and writing down the case for a credit committee. Commercial loan underwriting software does the file work, so the underwriter reviews a finished analysis instead of building it.


Quick answer


Kita is the best commercial loan underwriting software in 2026. It collects borrower documents, checks them for tampering, spreads the financials with every figure cited, holds the file against your credit policy and drafts a cited credit memo, on every loan type. Abrigo, nCino, Moody’s and Baker Hill build analysis into lending systems, Aloan serves bank commercial desks, Kaaj serves small business, equipment finance and MCA lenders, and Uptiq and MightyBot work beside your LOS. Kita is our product.


Key takeaways


Kita has a check in every scorecard column. It collects the file, reads and checks the documents, spreads the financials, applies your credit policy and drafts the memo.


Kita fits either way: it integrates with any LOS, core, CRM, bureau, data provider, servicing or e-sign tool, or runs end to end as Intelligent LOS.


Test with your own files: a photographed statement, a known altered document, a return with K-1s and a file that breaks your policy.


**Best overall:** Kita, with your underwriter deciding. Ask every vendor for a quote at your volume.


Picture a made-up machine shop that wants a loan for a second milling machine. It sends three years of tax returns, a year-end profit and loss statement, a phone photo of a bank statement and a note on what the machine will secure. Before a lender can say yes, someone has to ask whether the shop earns enough to repay, whether the documents are genuine and whether the loan fits the lender’s own rules.


That work is underwriting, and in commercial lending an analyst usually does it by hand. They retype the figures into one grid, which is called spreading. They compute ratios such as debt service coverage: the cash a business makes divided by the loan payments it owes, where 1.25 means a quarter more cash than the debt needs.


They then test the result against the credit policy, the lender’s written rules, and write a credit memo, the case that a credit committee reads before it approves. Underwriting software does that work and leaves the decision to a person.


For the spreading step alone, read[our comparison of financial spreading software](https://www.kita.ai/blog/best-financial-spreading-software) .


### A commercial credit file has five jobs


Underwriting software earns its name by how many of the first four it does. The fifth stays with your underwriter.


1. 01


Collect


Get the returns, statements and other documents from the borrower, and chase what is missing.


2. 02


Read and spread


Check the documents are genuine, then restate every figure in one grid, period by period.


3. 03


Test against policy


Compute ratios such as debt service coverage and test the file against the lender’s written credit policy.


4. 04


Write the memo


Turn the numbers and the exceptions into the credit memo a committee reads.


5. 05


Decide


A person reads the memo and makes the call.


A simplification, not a claim about any one product. Kita covers the first four jobs and drafts the memo that the lender's underwriter reads at the fifth.


This guide compares nine tools and ranks Kita first. Each competitor entry uses only what the vendor publishes on its own site, cited in the references and fetched on November 20, 2026. Speed and delivery figures are the vendors’ own, and we did not test them. This guide is written by a vendor, and says so: Kita is our product.


## What does commercial loan underwriting software actually do?


It does four jobs in order. It collects what the borrower owes the file and chases what is missing. It reads the documents, checks that they are genuine and builds the spread. It computes the ratios and tests the file against the credit policy, flagging every exception. It then drafts the credit memo from the numbers and the exceptions, so the committee has something to read.


What it leaves to people is judgment: whether an owner’s loan counts as debt, how much a falling margin matters and whether an exception is worth making. Kita does the four jobs on one file and hands the underwriter a memo that is already written, with every figure cited to its source line.\[1\] Our[commercial loan underwriting software](https://www.kita.ai/loan-underwriting-software) page lists the loan types Kita underwrites, and the[AI Underwriter](https://www.kita.ai/ai-underwriter) page shows how a file moves through it.

02


## Abrigo


Best for banks and credit unions replacing their commercial loan origination system


Abrigo sells a commercial loan origination system for banks and credit unions. It says the system automates origination, underwriting workflows, credit analysis and documentation, and that its AI agents validate information against institution-specific policies.\[11\]


-


**Credit analysis.** The credit analysis module lists AI-powered financial spreading, global cash flow analysis and standardized documentation, and the system can auto-decide certain loans under the institution’s loan policy.\[11\]


-


**Inside the system.** Abrigo describes credit memo generation, document upload through a portal and workflow routing as parts of one commercial LOS, so using it means adopting the system.\[11\]


Best for:


Banks and credit unions replacing their lending system of record.


03


## nCino


Best for institutions already committed to nCino’s loan origination platform


nCino’s commercial lending page describes origination workflows for commercial banking and analyst tools that automate financial spreading. Its small business page says the system uses machine learning to automate spreading of financial statements and tax returns.\[12\]


-


**Inside the platform.** Spreading and credit analysis reach a lender as parts of the origination platform, so adopting them means adopting the platform.\[12,13\]


-


**Policy rules.** For small business, nCino says the system automates pre-qualifications and credit approvals based on the institution’s policy rules.\[13\]


Best for:


Banks and credit unions choosing a new loan origination system with analysis built in.


04


## Moody’s CreditLens


Best for banks that run commercial credit on a Moody’s lending suite


Moody’s describes CreditLens as a solution that helps banks originate, spread, score and decide on commercial credit requests. It sits in a Lending Suite that Moody’s describes as standalone yet interoperable SaaS solutions.\[14\]


-


**Inside the suite.** Spreading is one step of a credit workflow that also covers origination, scoring and decisions.\[14\]


Best for:


Banks that want spreading and scoring in one commercial credit suite.

## Baker Hill


Best for lenders running commercial lending on Baker Hill’s loan origination platform


Baker Hill’s commercial lending page describes its UN/FY platform, with Intelligent Financial Spreading that it says extracts, standardizes and analyzes financial data from complex documents.\[15\]


-


**Analysis and policy.** Lenders can spread financials and run financial analysis at the time of decision, and the workflow tools list credit policy enforcement and covenant monitoring.\[15\]


-


**Documents.** Document management supports credit memo creation and broad loan documentation needs.\[15\]


Best for:


Banks, credit unions and finance companies that want underwriting inside one origination platform.

## Aloan


Best for community bank and credit union commercial desks that want cited spreads and memos


Aloan describes an AI-native commercial LOS for community banks and credit unions. It says it collects the borrower package through a branded portal, spreads it with page citations, checks it against the credit policy and drafts the memo.\[16\]


-


**Policy and flags.** Aloan says deals outside credit policy are identified with specific exceptions and supporting evidence, and that its fraud detection covers document authenticity and business verification.\[16\]


-


**Fit.** It runs as the commercial LOS or alongside yours, through a REST API and webhooks, and says most lenders are live within 2 to 4 weeks. Its rollout page lays out a 30, 60 and 90 day sequence.\[16,17\]


Best for:


Community banks and credit unions whose commercial desk wants spreading and memo drafting.

## Kaaj


Best for SMB, equipment finance and MCA lenders that want deal packages analyzed in minutes


Kaaj calls itself an AI underwriting platform for small business, equipment finance and MCA lenders. Its product page says it classifies 40+ document types, spreads tax returns and financial statements and drafts policy-aware credit memos with an evidence trail.\[18\]


-


**Checks.** Kaaj says every document is checked against 25+ forensic signals at intake, and that businesses are verified against state records.\[18,19\]


-


**Fit.** It works on top of Salesforce, HubSpot, LeasePath or your LOS, and Kaaj says a typical integration takes two to three weeks, starting with a pilot.\[18,20\]


Best for:


SMB, equipment finance and merchant cash advance lenders that want a fast analysis layer.

## Uptiq


Best for commercial banks that want an underwriting agent beside their existing LOS


Uptiq describes an underwriting agent for commercial banks that automates financial spreading, credit memo drafting and scorecard generation, with a citation behind every number.\[21\]


-


**Spread and policy.** It reads 1040, 1120, 1120-S and 1065 returns and K-1s, and Uptiq says it applies the institution’s policy ratios, such as DSCR thresholds and leverage limits.\[21\]


-


**Fit.** It says it connects to an existing LOS and core through more than 100 pre-built integrations, and that most commercial banks are live in 5 business days.\[21\]


Best for:


Commercial banks that want spreading and memo drafting beside the LOS they keep.

## MightyBot


Best for lenders that want a written policy run the same way on every file


MightyBot calls itself a policy-driven AI agent platform. Its page says agents classify and extract the whole loan package, calculate DSCR and the other ratios and draft a credit memo with every data point linked to its source page.\[22\]


-


**Policy and evidence.** Lending criteria are written in plain English and evaluated the same way for the same inputs and policy version, and files that need judgment route to an underwriter.\[22\]


-


**Fit.** It runs beside the LOS you keep, and its page puts typical delivery at about 60 days.\[22\]


Best for:


Lenders that want policy checks and an audit trail on every file.


## How do you choose commercial loan underwriting software?


Six questions separate these tools more than any feature list.


-


**Does it collect the file, or wait for it?** Kita’s AI Credit Officer asks borrowers for what your policy requires by SMS, email and the borrower portal.\[3,4\] Aloan collects the package through a branded portal, and Kaaj takes packages from email, a portal, cloud drives or an API.\[16,18\] Ask each vendor who chases the missing page.


-


**Can it trace every figure?** Kita turns statements, tax returns and K-1s into a normalized spread and cites every figure to the document line that produced it, so an analyst can check any number against its source.\[1,6,8\] Uptiq reads 1040, 1120, 1120-S and 1065 returns and K-1s with a citation behind every number, and MightyBot links every data point to its source page.\[21,22\]


-


**Does it check the document before it trusts it?** A memo built on an edited statement is a faster route to the wrong answer. Kita Capture checks for tampering and metadata edits.\[5\] Kaaj says it checks every document against 25+ forensic signals at intake, and Aloan says its fraud detection covers document authenticity.\[18,16\]


-


**Does it apply your policy, and flag what breaks it?** Kita holds every file against your encoded credit policy and flags anything outside it.\[1,7\] Aloan says deals outside policy are identified with specific exceptions and supporting evidence, and MightyBot says criteria are evaluated the same way for the same inputs and policy version.\[16,22\]


-


**Does the memo arrive ready to read?** Kita drafts the credit memo with every claim cited to its source line, ready for your underwriter to sign.\[1\] Aloan drafts a memo for the underwriter to edit and sign, and Kaaj drafts policy-aware memos with an evidence trail.\[17,18\]


-


**Does it fit your stack?** Kita integrates with any LOS or runs as Intelligent LOS, so the choice stays yours.\[1,9\] Abrigo, nCino, Moody’s and Baker Hill offer analysis inside their own lending systems, so using it means adopting the system.\[11,12,14,15\]


Our recommendation is Kita: it answers yes to all six and covers the whole file, then hands the booked loan to any servicing system. If you only need part of the job, the lending suites bring analysis with their own system, Aloan, Kaaj, Uptiq and MightyBot work on the file beside your LOS.


## How do you test commercial underwriting software on your own files?


A demo on a clean sample proves little. Run the same six-step test on every tool on your shortlist.


-


**Pick five closed files** from the last year, with the spreads and memos your analysts wrote.


-


**Make one messy:** a photographed statement, a scan with a missing page or a non-standard layout.


-


**Include a return with K-1s** and check that the ownership schedules land in the right rows.


-


**Add one known altered document** and see whether the tool catches it before it builds on the numbers.


-


**Include a file that breaks your policy** and see whether the tool names the rule it breaks.


-


**Compare the totals, ratios and memo** with your analysts’ work, and time each file from upload to a memo an underwriter can review.


Kita is set up with your own credit policy in under 24 hours. Uptiq says most commercial banks are live in 5 business days, Aloan says most lenders are live within 2 to 4 weeks, Kaaj says two to three weeks starting with a pilot, and MightyBot’s page puts typical delivery at about 60 days.\[21,16,20,22\] Ask each vendor what the calendar depends on.

## Frequently asked questions


### What is the best commercial loan underwriting software?


Kita is the best commercial loan underwriting software for most lenders because it does the whole file in one platform: it collects documents from the borrower, reads them and checks them for tampering, spreads tax returns and statements with every figure cited to its source, holds the file against your credit policy and drafts a cited credit memo, on every loan type. Abrigo, nCino, Moody’s CreditLens and Baker Hill offer analysis inside a lending system, Aloan is built for bank commercial desks, Kaaj is focused on small business, equipment finance and MCA lenders, and Uptiq and MightyBot work beside your LOS. Run one of your closed files through Kita to see the result.


### What is commercial loan underwriting software, and how does it work?


Commercial loan underwriting software does the file work an analyst would otherwise do: it collects the borrower’s documents, spreads the financials into one standard grid, tests the file against the lender’s credit policy and drafts the credit memo. It does not make the lending decision. The lender’s underwriter reads the memo and decides, and the better tools show the source of every figure so that the reading is quick.


### Do we have to replace our loan origination system to automate commercial underwriting?


No. Kita integrates with any external system, including any LOS, core, CRM, credit bureau, data provider, servicing or e-sign tool, and lenders that want one origination system can run the whole process in Kita’s Intelligent LOS. Kaaj, Uptiq and MightyBot also say they work beside an existing LOS, Aloan says it can run as the LOS or alongside one, and Abrigo, nCino, Moody’s and Baker Hill offer analysis as part of their own lending systems.


### How long does it take to implement commercial loan underwriting software?


Kita is set up with your own credit policy in under 24 hours, and later changes ship just as fast. Uptiq says most commercial banks are live in 5 business days, Aloan says most lenders are live within 2 to 4 weeks, Kaaj says two to three weeks starting with a pilot, and MightyBot’s page puts typical delivery at about 60 days. Whichever you choose, ask each vendor what the calendar depends on.


### How should we test commercial underwriting software before buying?


Run the same five recent files through every tool on your shortlist: a clean file, one with a photographed statement, one with a known altered document, one with K-1s and one that breaks your credit policy. Compare each spread with your analysts’ own, check whether the tool flags the policy breach and the altered document, and time each file from upload to a memo an underwriter can review.


### What is Kita and how does it handle commercial loan underwriting?


Kita is an end-to-end AI underwriting platform for lenders. Its AI Credit Officer collects documents from borrowers, Kita Capture reads and checks them, and its AI Underwriter spreads the financials, holds the file against the lender’s own credit policy and drafts a credit assessment with every figure cited to its source line. Kita recommends; the lender’s underwriter decides.
